Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, I ask You by Your name
In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful
O Lord of Majesty and Honor
O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting
O Ever-Living, there is no god except You

Arabic text: يَا هُوَ يَا مَنْ لَايَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ
Translation: O He, O One whom no one knows what He is
Nor how He is
Nor where He is
Nor how He exists except He Himself
O Lord of the Kingdom and Dominion
O Lord of Might and Power

Arabic text: يَا مَلِكُ يَا قُدُّوْسُ يَا سَلامُ
Translation: O Sovereign, O Holy, O Peace
O Giver of Faith, O Guardian

Arabic text: يَا عَزِيزُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا مُتَكَبِّرُ
Translation: O Mighty, O Compeller, O Supreme

Arabic text: يَا خَالِقُ يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ
Translation: O Creator, O Maker, O Fashioner
O Benefactor, O Administrator
O Mighty, O Originator
O Restorer, O Destroyer

Arabic text: يَا وَدُودُ يَا مَحْمُودُ يَا مَعْبُودُ
Translation: O Loving, O Praiseworthy, O Worshipped One
O Far, O Near

Arabic text: يَا مُجِيبُ يَا رَقِيبُ يَا حَسِيبُ
Translation: O Responsive, O Watchful, O Reckoner
O Innovator, O Exalter
O Impregnable, O All-Hearing

Arabic text: يَا عَلِيمُ يَا حَلِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
Translation: O All-Knowing, O Forbearing, O Generous
O Wise, O Eternal
O Most High, O Great
O Compassionate, O Bestower
O Judge, O Helper
O Majestic, O Beautiful
O Guardian, O Guarantor
O Pardoner, O Giver
O Noble, O Guide
O Guide, O Initiator
O First, O Last
O Manifest, O Hidden
O Upright, O Everlasting
O Knower, O Ruler
O Judge, O Just
O Separator, O Connector
O Pure, O Purifier
O Powerful, O All-Powerful
O Great, O Supreme

Arabic text: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
Translation: O One, O Only, O Eternal

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
Translation: O He who begets not, nor was He begotten
And there is none comparable to Him
And He has no spouse
And He has no minister
And He does not take any advisor
And He needs no supporter

Arabic text: وَلَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ
Translation: And there is no god with Him besides Him
There is no god except You

Arabic text: فَتَعَالَيْتَ عَمَّا يَقُولُ الظَّالِمُوْنَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
Translation: You are far exalted above what the wrongdoers say, with great exaltation

Arabic text: يَا عَلِيُّ يَا شَامِخُ يَا بَاذِخُ
Translation: O Most High, O Lofty, O Magnificent

Arabic text: يَا فَتَّاحُ يَا نَفَّاحُ يَا مُرْتَاحُ
Translation: O Opener, O Bestower, O Comforter

Arabic text: يَا مُفَرِّجُ يَا نَاصِرُ يَا مُنْتَصِرُ
Translation: O Reliever, O Helper, O Victor

Arabic text: يَا مُدْرِكُ يَا مُهْلِكُ يَا مُنْتَقِمُ
Translation: O Overtaker, O Destroyer, O Avenger
O Resurrector, O Inheritor
O Seeker, O Overcomer
O He from whom no fugitive can escape

Arabic text: يَا تَوَّابُ يَا أَوَّابُ يَا وَهَّابُ
Translation: O Acceptor of Repentance, O Ever-Returning, O Bestower
O Creator of Causes
O Opener of Doors

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ حَيْثُ مَا دُعِيَ أَجَابَ
Translation: O He who answers wherever He is called
O Pure, O Appreciative
O Pardoner, O Forgiving
O Light of Light
O Manager of Affairs
O Subtle, O Aware
O Protector, O Illuminator

Arabic text: يَا بَصِيرُ يَا ظَهِيرُ يَا كَبِيرُ
Translation: O All-Seeing, O Supporter, O Great
O Odd, O Unique

Arabic text: يَا أَبَدُ يَا سَنَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
Translation: O Eternal, O Support, O Eternal
O Sufficient, O Healer
O Faithful, O Giver of Health
O Benefactor, O Beautifier
O Bestower, O Favorer
O Gracious, O Unique
O He who is high and dominates
O He who possesses and determines
O He who is hidden yet aware
O He who is worshipped and shows gratitude
O He who is disobeyed yet forgives
O He whom thoughts cannot comprehend
And whom no sight can perceive
And from whom no trace is hidden
O Provider for mankind
O Determiner of every destiny
O Most High in position
O Firm in strength
O Transformer of times
O Acceptor of sacrifice
O Lord of Favor and Goodness
O Lord of Might and Authority
O Merciful, O Beneficent

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ هُوَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ فِيْ شَأْنٍ
Translation: O He who is every day engaged in some affair

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَايَشْغَلُهُ شَأْنٌ عَنْ شَأْنٍ
Translation: O He whom no affair distracts from another affair
O Great in Glory
O He who is in every place
O Hearer of all voices
O Answerer of prayers
O Fulfiller of requests
O Satisfier of needs
O Sender of blessings
O One who has mercy on tears
O Forgiver of slips
O Reliever of afflictions
O Guardian of good deeds
O Raiser of ranks
O Granter of requests
O Reviver of the dead
O Gatherer of what is scattered
O Observer of intentions
O Restorer of what has passed
O He to whom voices are not confusing
O He whom requests do not annoy
And whom darkness does not cover
O Light of the earth and the heavens
O Perfector of blessings
O Repeller of calamities
O Creator of souls
O Gatherer of nations
O Healer of disease
O Creator of light and darkness
O Lord of Generosity and Bounty

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَا يَطَأُ عَرْشَهُ قَدَمٌ
Translation: O He whose throne no foot can reach
O Most Generous of the generous
O Most Honorable of the honorable
O Most Hearing of listeners
O Most Seeing of observers
O Protector of those who seek protection
O Security of the fearful
O Support of refugees
O Guardian of believers
O Helper of those who seek help
O Ultimate Goal of seekers
O Companion of every stranger
O Intimate of every loner
O Refuge of every outcast
O Shelter of every wanderer
O Keeper of every lost thing
O One who has mercy on the aged elder
O Provider for the small child
O Mender of broken bones
O Liberator of all prisoners
O Enricher of the destitute poor
O Protection of the frightened seeker of refuge
O He who has control and determination

Arabic text: يَا مَنِ الْعَسِيرُ عَلَيْهِ سَهْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
Translation: O He for whom the difficult is easy and simple
O He who needs no explanation

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: O He who has power over everything

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَبِيرٌ
Translation: O He who is aware of everything

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ
Translation: O He who sees everything
O Sender of winds
O Cleaver of dawn
O Resurrector of souls
O Lord of Generosity and Tolerance
O He in whose hand is every key
O Hearer of every voice
O Preceder of every escaper

Arabic text: يَا مُحْيِيَ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ
Translation: O Giver of life to every soul after death
O my Provision in my hardship
O my Protector in my exile
O my Companion in my solitude
O my Guardian in my blessing
O my Refuge when paths exhaust me
And relatives abandon me
And every companion forsakes me

Arabic text: يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لَا عِمَادَ لَهُ
Translation: O Support of the one who has no support
O Pillar of the one who has no pillar
O Treasure of the one who has no treasure
O Shelter of the one who has no shelter
O Refuge of the one who has no refuge
O Store of the one who has no store
O Support of the one who has no support
O Helper of the one who has no helper
O Neighbor of the one who has no neighbor
O my Close Neighbor
O my Firm Support
O my God in truth
O Lord of the Ancient House
O Compassionate, O Kind
Release me from the ring of constraint

Arabic text: وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ هَمٍّ وَغَمٍّ وَضِيقٍ
Translation: And remove from me every worry, grief, and distress
And protect me from the evil that I cannot bear
And help me with what I can bear
O He who returned Joseph to Jacob
O He who removed the affliction of Job
O He who forgave the sin of David

Arabic text: يَا رَافِعَ عِيسَىٰ بْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَمُنْجِيَهُ مِنْ أَيْدِيْ الْيَهُودِ
Translation: O He who raised Jesus son of Mary and saved him from the hands of the Jews

Arabic text: يَا مُجِيبَ نِدَاءِ يُونُسَ فِيْ الظُّلُمَاتِ
Translation: O He who answered the call of Jonah in the darkness
O He who chose Moses with His words
O He who forgave Adam's mistake
And raised Idris to a lofty place by His mercy

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ نُوحًا مِنَ الْغَرَقِ
Translation: O He who saved Noah from drowning
O He who destroyed the first 'Ad
And Thamud, so none remained
And the people of Noah before
They were indeed most unjust and most rebellious
And the overthrown cities He also destroyed

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ دَمَّرَ عَلَى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
Translation: O He who destroyed the people of Lot
And crushed the people of Shuaib
O He who took Abraham as a friend
O He who took Moses as a speaker

Arabic text: وَاتَّخَذَ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ حَبِيبًا
Translation: And took Muhammad, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family and all of them, as a beloved
O Giver of wisdom to Luqman
And Bestower to Solomon of a kingdom
That was not fitting for anyone after him

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ نَصَرَ ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ عَلَى الْمُلُوكِ الْجَبَابِرَةِ
Translation: O He who helped Dhul-Qarnayn against the tyrannical kings
O He who gave Khidr life

Arabic text: وَرَدَّ لِيُوشَعَ بْنِ نُونٍ الشَّمْسَ بَعْدَ غُرُوبِهَا
Translation: And returned the sun for Joshua son of Nun after it had set

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ رَبَطَ عَلَى قَلْبِ أُمِّ مُوسٰى
Translation: O He who strengthened the heart of Moses' mother
And protected the chastity of Mary daughter of Imran

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ حَصَّنَ يَحْيَى بْنَ زَكَرِيَّا مِنَ الذَّنْبِ
Translation: O He who preserved Yahya son of Zakariya from sin
And calmed the anger of Moses
O He who gave Zakariya glad tidings of Yahya

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ فَدَىٰ إِسْمَاعِيلَ مِنَ الذَّبْحِ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
Translation: O He who ransomed Ismail from sacrifice with a great sacrifice
O He who accepted the offering of Abel
And placed the curse on Cain

Arabic text: يَا هَازِمَ الْأَحْزَابِ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Defeater of the confederates for Muhammad, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And upon all the Messengers and Your close angels
And all those who obey You

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ مَسْأَلَةٍ سَأَلَكَ بِهَا أَحَدٌ
Translation: And I ask You by every request anyone has asked of You

Arabic text: مِمَّنْ رَضِيتَ عَنْهُ فَحَتَمْتَ لَهُ عَلَى الْإِجَابَةِ
Translation: Among those You were pleased with and guaranteed an answer to

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
Translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah

Arabic text: يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
Translation: O Beneficent, O Beneficent, O Beneficent

Arabic text: يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ
Translation: O Merciful, O Merciful, O Merciful
O Lord of Majesty and Honor
O Lord of Majesty and Honor
O Lord of Majesty and Honor

Arabic text: بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ
Translation: By Him, by Him, by Him, by Him, by Him, by Him, by Him

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ
Translation: I ask You by every name You have named Yourself

Arabic text: أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِيْ شَيْءٍ مِنْ كُتُبِكَ
Translation: Or have revealed in any of Your books

Arabic text: أَوِ اسْتَأَثَرْتَ بِهِ فِيْ عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: Or have kept exclusively in the knowledge of the unseen with You
And by the points of honor on Your throne
And by the ultimate extent of mercy in Your Book

Arabic text: وَبِمَا لَوْ أَنَّ مٰا فِيْ الْأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلٰامٌ
Translation: And by that which if all the trees on earth were pens

Arabic text: وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ
Translation: And the sea, replenished by seven more seas after it
The words of Allah would not be exhausted
Indeed, Allah is Mighty, Wise
And I ask You by Your beautiful names
Which You have described in Your Book, saying:
"To Allah belong the most beautiful names, so call upon Him by them"
And You said, "Call upon Me, I will answer you"

Arabic text: وَقُلْتَ وَإِذٰا سَأَلَكَ عِبٰادِيْ عَنِّيْ فَإِنِّيْ قَرِيبٌ
Translation: And You said, "When My servants ask you about Me, I am indeed near
I answer the call of the caller when he calls upon Me"

Arabic text: وَقُلْتَ يٰا عِبٰادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ أَسْرَفُوْا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ
Translation: And You said, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah
Indeed, Allah forgives all sins
He is indeed the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful"
And I ask You, O my God
And I call upon You, O my Lord
And I hope in You, O my Master

Arabic text: وَأَطْمَعُ فِيْ إِجَابَتِيْ يَا مَوْلَايَ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِي
Translation: And I aspire for Your answer, O my Protector, as You have promised me
And I have called upon You as You commanded me

Arabic text: فَافْعَلْ بِىْ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ يَا كَرِيمُ
Translation: So treat me as befits You, O Generous One
And all praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
Translation: And may Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad and all his family
